_metadata.description: Reusable, safe browser voice-input lifecycle and presentation capability.

requirements.title: Voice input has one owner, one clock, and one terminal cleanup funnel
requirements.description: The versioned hook owns injected capture, timer, cue, and adapter seams. Always-on mode does not stop on silence; timeout mode is the only automatic termination clock; terminal cleanup is idempotent.

requirements.title: Voice Input Button is preview-safe and adoption-ready
requirements.description: The cataloged button has fake-backed state specimens, accessible labels, no preview permission acquisition, and a version-pinned hook dependency closure.
